item.title: Gloss paper is published in Cell Reports Methods!
item.description: The Gloss paper is published in Cell Reports Methods! It introduces a new predictive model for multi-modal data combining scRNA-seq with LIPSTIC measurments of direct physical cell-cell interactions. This allows systematically linking gene and pathway activity to LIPSTIC-measured interaction strength. Congratulations to all authors, especially to the lead author Tamjeed Azad!

item.title: Dr. Jonathan Mitchel joins the lab as a postdoctoral researcher. Welcome Jonathan!
Sarah Walker successfully defends PhD today. Huge congratulations Dr. Walker!
Gabe Dolsten successfully defends PhD today. Huge congratulations Dr. Dolsten! The first PhD from the lab!
Treg Foxp3 degradation paper is published in Nature Immunology!
item.description:
The paper exploring the role of Foxp3 in Treg cells using a new experimental system of inducible protein degradation is published in Nature Immunology!

Exciting collaboration with the labs of Alexander Rudensky at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center and Wei Hu at Yale School of Medicine. Congratulations to all authors, including our own Gabe Dolsten who performed all computational data analysis for this study!

item.title: Drosophila embryo Micro-C paper is published in Cell Genomics!
item.description:
Our paper with extensive 3D chromatin architecture analysis of early Drosophila embryogenesis is published in Cell Genomics!

Exciting collaboration with the labs of Mike Levine and Olga Troyanskaya at the Lewis-Sigler Institute, Princeton University. Congratulations to all authors, especially to the lead author Gabe Dolsten!

item.title: Pritykin lab joins the Weill Cancer Hub East
item.description: The Pritykin lab joins and receives funding from the new Weill Cancer Hub East. This will allow us to extend our studies of the immune microenvironments in cancer using experimental and computational genomics in mouse models and human samples, and will enable new collaboration with researchers of the hub coming from the Rockefeller University, Weill Cornell Medicine and Princeton University including the Ludwig Princeton Branch.

item.title: Yuri co-organizes a new regular track Computational Systems Immunology at ISMB 2025
item.description: Yuri co-organizes a new Community of Special Interest (COSI) and a regular session Computational Systems Immunology starting this year at ISMB 2025 in Liverpool, UK. ISMB is the premier international conference on computational biology and bioinformatics. See you there!

item.title: The GuideScan2 paper is published in Genome Biology!
item.description:
The GuideScan2 paper is published in Genome Biology! We are introducing a new CRISPR guide RNA design and analysis method, available as an open source software package and a user-friendly web interface.

Exciting collaboration with the labs of Christina Leslie and Andrea Ventura at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, and congratulations to co-first authors Henri Schmidt and Minsi Zhang!

item.title: The uLIPSTIC paper is published in Nature!
item.description: The uLIPSTIC paper is published in Nature, with Yuri as co-corresponding author! Exciting and fruitful collaboration with the lab of Gabriel Victora at Rockefeller University. Excited about multiple other ongoing uLIPSTIC projects with the Victora lab, stay tuned.
